meta.name: board-deck-builder
meta.description: Assembles comprehensive board and investor update decks by pulling perspectives from all C-suite roles. Use when preparing board meetings, investor updates, quarterly business reviews, or fundraising narratives. Covers structure, narrative framework, bad news delivery, and common mistakes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成董事会和投资人汇报材料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要准备面向董事会或投资人的正式汇报材料
copy.tagline_en: Quickly assemble board and investor update decks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare formal presentations for board or investors

howto.what: Claude 会把用户提供的业务数据整理成董事会或投资人汇报 deck,按固定章节输出(摘要、指标、财务、收入、产品、增长、工程、人事、风险、展望、附录);缺失的数据用占位符标出,绝不编造数字。
howto.when: 当用户要求准备董事会材料、投资人更新、季度业务回顾等场合时触发;也接受直接输入“做一个季度董事会 deck”并注明轮次。

say.text: 做一个季度董事会 deck,我们是 A 轮。
say.note: 按标准章节生成完整 deck。

say.text: 起草一份种子轮公司的融资董事会 deck。
say.note: 采用融资结构,结尾带 ask。

say.text: 这是本季度指标,帮我生成 deck,缺的用占位符。
say.note: 按标准顺序整理并补齐叙事。

howto.what_en: Claude assembles a board/investor deck from user data into fixed sections (summary, metrics, finance, pipeline, product, growth, engineering, people, risk, outlook, appendix), using placeholders for missing numbers — never inventing figures.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to prepare board materials, investor updates, quarterly business reviews, or fundraising narratives; also from direct requests like 'build a quarterly board deck' with stage named.

say_en.text: Build a quarterly board deck — we're Series A.
Draft a fundraising board deck for a seed-stage company.
Here are our metrics; fill gaps with placeholders.
say_en.note: Organizes the deck and adds narrative.
